title: Green Anacondas Weigh Hundreds of Pounds and Ambush Caimans

scenes.text: This snake ambushes caimans in the mud.
A green anaconda can reach about 26 feet and hundreds of pounds.
It waits in shallow, muddy water for animals to come and drink.
It lunges, bites, and wraps its body around the prey.
It tightens its coils with every breath the prey takes.
Then it swallows it whole, and may not need to eat again for weeks.

description:
Green anacondas can reach about 26 feet and hundreds of pounds.
They ambush caimans and other prey from shallow water, squeeze them, and swallow them whole.
Would you step in that water?
first_comment: Which giant snake do you find scariest?
